slots.title: Phase 1: Aware
slots.label: Know before you need.
slots.gapLine: The furnace picked the coldest night in January.
slots.otherLine: Some homes knew its age back in October.

slots.title: Step 1: Baseline
slots.gapLine: Your inspection report is in a folder from the year you moved in.
slots.otherLine: Some homes have a first page: every system, its age, its condition, dated this fall.

slots.title: Step 2: Inspect
slots.gapLine: The roof got looked at the day the ceiling stained.
slots.otherLine: Some homes had someone on the gutters in October, fir needles and all.

slots.title: Step 3: Track
slots.gapLine: When was the roof done? Somewhere in the drawer.
slots.otherLine: Some homes answer that with a date, a name, and a photo.

slots.title: Phase 2: Act
slots.label: Fix small before it is big.
slots.gapLine: The list only gets shorter when something breaks.
slots.otherLine: Some homes cross off the small things in spring, while they are still small.

slots.title: Step 4: Prioritize
slots.gapLine: The accent wall got done. The loose handrail is still loose.
slots.otherLine: Some homes fix the handrail first and paint in March with nothing hanging over them.

slots.title: Step 5: Schedule
slots.gapLine: The gutters were a fall job. It is April.
slots.otherLine: Some homes have the gutters, the filter, and the dryer vent on the calendar with a date.

slots.title: Step 6: Execute
slots.gapLine: Three quotes, two no-shows, and the window still sticks.
slots.otherLine: Some homes know which jobs are a Saturday with a caulk gun and which ones get a call.

slots.title: Phase 3: Advance
slots.label: Build wealth through property care.
slots.gapLine: Every year the house finds a new way to cost money.
slots.otherLine: Some homes have systems that keep going, and a record that shows why.

slots.title: Step 7: Preserve
slots.gapLine: The water heater quit at nine years. Nobody ever flushed it.
slots.otherLine: Some tanks get flushed every fall, the way the manufacturer's manual asks.

slots.title: Step 8: Upgrade
slots.gapLine: The new kitchen went in. The roof was next year's problem.
slots.otherLine: Some homes do the roof first, then pick the kitchen they actually want.

slots.title: Step 9: Scale
slots.gapLine: The biggest thing your family owns arrives as a statement in the mail.
slots.otherLine: Some families walk into a refinance with years of the home's care on paper.
slots.footnote: Education for homeowners, not financial advice.
